title: The two current-linked Milan timetables conflict with the current T2S baseline
evidence: [Instructions to Settlement Service and related instrumental activities - in force as of 30 June 2025](https://www.euronext.com/sites/default/files/2025-07/03%20Settlement%20Service%20Instructions_30062025_WITHOUT%20EVIDENCE.pdf) — 30 June 2025, PDF 13 (printed 9): NTS 19:30; PDF 15 (printed 11): two partial windows

[Istruzioni del Servizio di Liquidazione e dei servizi accessori - in vigore dal 30 giugno 2025](https://www.euronext.com/sites/default/files/2025-07/03%20Istruzioni%20Servizio%20di%20Liquidazione_30062025_SENZA%20evidenza.pdf) — Italian original, PDF 12 and 15: same stale timetable

[T2S User Detailed Functional Specifications R2026.JUN (UDFS)](https://www.ecb.europa.eu/paym/target/target-professional-use-documents-links/t2s/sdd/shared/pdf/T2S_UDFS_R2026.JUN_clean_20260122.en.pdf) — R2026.JUN, Table 37 PDF 160: NTS 20:00; PDF 162: five partial windows

[Regulations as of 26 January 2026](https://www.euronext.com/sites/default/files/2026-02/01%20REG_UNICO_ENG_WITHOUT%20EV_26012026.pdf) — 26 January 2026, Articles 66–67 PDF 48–49: notices and ECB operating documents
likely_answer_error: A current-only query can return 19:30 or two partial windows, while the current platform specification gives 20:00 and five. Italian precedence does not resolve this conflict because both Milan languages contain it.
correction: Quarantine the two timetable passages. For T2S baseline questions use R2026.JUN with dated status notices. Obtain current Milan participant cut-offs/notice chain before answering local submission deadlines; do not invalidate the entire settlement manual.

title: A normal timetable is insufficient for a dated operational question
evidence: [t2s-2026-status-events](https://www.ecb.europa.eu/paym/target/html/t2s_history_2026_include.en.html) — 8 September 2026 updates at 15:30, 18:10 and 18:55

[T2S User Detailed Functional Specifications R2026.JUN (UDFS)](https://www.ecb.europa.eu/paym/target/target-professional-use-documents-links/t2s/sdd/shared/pdf/T2S_UDFS_R2026.JUN_clean_20260122.en.pdf) — R2026.JUN PDF 157: day-specific extensions/contingencies
likely_answer_error: An answer about 8 September can assert a 16:00 EUR DvP cut-off even though the official notice postponed it to 17:00. Later incident updates affected the end of day.
correction: Add dated ECB operational status events as scoped exceptions. The 15:30 notice moved EUR DvP by 60 minutes; the 18:55 update says the incident was resolved and IFOP closed at 18:39. Store event time, affected business date/currency, superseding update and whether planned or actual; never turn that exception into the permanent calendar.

title: The admitted ISIN workbook mixes listing data and a future programme
evidence: [ISINs eligible for settlement in Euronext Securities Milan 2026-09-11](https://www.euronext.com/sites/default/files/2026-09/ISINs%20eligible%20for%20settlement%20in%20Euronext%20Securities%20Milan%202026-09-11.xlsx?VersionId=W9q4Cxr4Dog5dqZVMCUwWuDNNnIFGBUR) — Introduction B5:B8; Equities I1/K1/L1 and A2/I2/K2/L2; International ETPs alternative columns
Existing curated-manifest.json: default_retrieval=true; no text_path
likely_answer_error: It may identify Euronext as the current designated place on 13 September, or establish Milan eligibility for any ISIN. The workbook instead describes selected European Offering instruments, data through 10 September, with designated/alternative places applying from 21 September.
correction: Remove whole-workbook admission. Split column-level dates/scope, preserve all alternative columns and disclaimers, and use a verified ISIN/link register (including relevant MT-X MT23 data) for operational eligibility. Do not silently rename future columns as current.

title: Whole-document defaults exceed the recorded review and metadata controls
evidence: curated-manifest.json: 49 documents marked default_retrieval=true; 38 have empty reviewed_pdf_pages (not proof that no prior reading occurred). Twelve legal captures are also admitted.
scripts/finalize_library.py: layer-based default selection; no deployed retriever/chunker found

[Corporate_Events_Services_User_Guide_20260507_clean.pdf](https://www.euronext.com/sites/default/files/2026-05/Euronext%20Securities%20-%20Corporate%20Events%20Service%20-%20CA4U%20Handbook%20SDD%20-%20V05_0.pdf) — May 2026, PDF 16–17: service/role scope is narrower than the group brand
likely_answer_error: A broad current/reference label can mix CSD operator duties with participant duties, private interfaces with native T2S, specialist forms with operating rules, or four-CSD corporate-events material with Athens.
correction: Replace defaults with approved propositions and parent sections. Require entity, market, service, role, language, release, security/link/currency context and effective period where material. Unknown required values block operational answers. Treat programme material, historical disclosures and generated explanations separately.

title: Text extraction can omit the very requirements a query needs
evidence: [T2S User Detailed Functional Specifications R2026.JUN (UDFS)](https://www.ecb.europa.eu/paym/target/target-professional-use-documents-links/t2s/sdd/shared/pdf/T2S_UDFS_R2026.JUN_clean_20260122.en.pdf) — PDF 269, Diagram 55 and footnote 194: matching fields visible in original but missing from text extraction
evidence/aa3d5a3b94c9-p269.png; original extraction contains the diagram caption without its field matrix
Catalogue flags 98 PDFs / 250 low-text pages; 14 archives have member inventories but no audited member extraction
likely_answer_error: A schema or matching answer can be incomplete despite a text-rich page and successful extraction. Archive containers can conceal relevant XSD/XML; one nominal ZIP is an XLSX package.
correction: Extract tables/diagrams as structured content plus image and page references; validate cell/field counts and footnotes. Keep payment-type conditions and exceptions with fields. Identify MIME by content, unpack archives in a controlled staging area, deduplicate members and validate XSD dependencies before admission. Do not fill omissions from model memory.

title: DORA’s English-labelled capture contains French operative text
evidence: [DORA: consolidated 27 December 2022](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX:02022R2554-20221227) — Original browser capture and live recapture, Articles 2 and 64: French body under English navigation
[Regulation - 2022/2554 - EN - DORA - EUR-Lex Log in English](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2022/2554/oj/eng) — English OJ replacement, Articles 2(1)(g) and 64
likely_answer_error: Language filters or English exact-quote requests can retrieve French clauses and silently translate them as verbatim English evidence.
correction: Preserve the original French capture and tag the actual body language. Use the fetched English OJ replacement for the reviewed provisions; verify language at body/chunk level. The law itself is not invalidated by a capture-label defect.
